title: RealFactBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Real-World Fact-Checking
authors: Shuo Yang; Yuqin Dai; Guoqing Wang; Xinran Zheng; Jinfeng Xu; Jinze Li; Zhenzhe Ying; Weiqiang Wang; Edith C. H. Ngai
why_relevant: Introduces a fact-checking benchmark with an 'Unknown Rate' metric that measures over-conservatism vs over-confidence and evaluates LLMs with web retrieval tools, touching on uncertainty handling.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on fact-checking task evaluation rather than RAG robustness under unreliable evidence; retrieval reliability, conflict, or adversarial aspects are not central.
